answer: Like mycelial tides filtering through a subterranean lagoon, decentralized consensus purges synthetic clones by demanding recursive proof of symbiotic transit. Each peer reflects a unique cryptographic mirror of mutual resource flows rather than hollow stake. When a malicious nebula of fake identities blooms, cross-verifying disjoint trust paths imposes a superlinear attacker cost: multiplying nodes forces polynomial path validation across the lattice, rendering mass infiltration economically ruinous.
